review_scope: Public historical comparator cases, not a company-ranked harm dataset or precedent for automatic legal claims

cases.title: Minamata disease
cases.subject: Chisso (historical Minamata facility)
cases.finding_kind: Government causation assessment and court compensation decision
cases.statement: Japan's government concluded in 1968 that methylmercury discharged in industrial effluent accumulated through seafood and caused disease; a March 1973 court decision established Chisso's compensation responsibility for the Kumamoto case.

key_figure.label: court decision
key_figure.meaning: Year of initial Kumamoto damages judgment, not an injury count

sources.title: Japan Ministry of the Environment · 1995 environmental report

cases.caveat: Historical, site-specific determination. Does not establish present-day exposure or extrapolate to all current chemical producers.

cases.title: Deepwater Horizon
cases.subject: BP / Macondo well (2010)
cases.finding_kind: Government-documented spill and court-approved civil settlement
cases.statement: The U.S. Department of the Interior records an approximately 134-million-gallon release over 87 days following the April 2010 well blowout; a court approved a $20.8 billion settlement in April 2016 over civil penalties and natural-resource damages.

key_figure.label: released oil (approx.)
key_figure.meaning: Event-specific spill magnitude, not a universal toxicity equivalent

sources.title: U.S. Department of the Interior · settlement announcement

cases.caveat: Civil monetary terms include different categories. Settlement value is not a directly measured ecological loss.

cases.title: Brumadinho dam rupture
cases.subject: Vale / Córrego do Feijão (2019)
cases.finding_kind: Government-documented dam failure and judicial repair agreement
cases.statement: Minas Gerais records 272 deaths following the January 2019 rupture and a February 2021 judicial agreement with Vale for collective repair, with an estimated value of approximately R$37.69 billion.

key_figure.label: event-specific human toll
key_figure.meaning: Government-documented disaster death count, not a prediction for any other site

sources.title: Minas Gerais government · Brumadinho judicial agreement

cases.caveat: Collective repair agreement, individual actions and criminal proceedings are distinct. Do not equate announced agreement amount with measured total harm.

cases.title: Public-water-supplier PFAS settlement
cases.subject: 3M / public water supplier claims
cases.statement: 3M reported final court approval of its U.S. public-water-supplier settlement in March 2024. The settlement provides for payments over time and expressly does not constitute an admission of liability or wrongdoing.

key_figure.label: no injury estimate
key_figure.meaning: Water-supplier settlement scope is not proof of any individual's disease

cases.caveat: Public-water-supplier remedies are distinct from individualized health allegations; the company expressly denies admission of wrongdoing.
